# Montesummano Analysis

In this section follows the forecast analysis for Montesummano station measurements.

## 1. Data Loading

```{r}
data_ms <- find_data("data/Monte_Summano.csv")
data_ms

```

## 2. Exploratory Visualization

```{r, warning=FALSE}
temp_min_ms <- data_ms[[1]]$GEN
temp_mean_ms <- data_ms[[2]]$GEN
temp_max_ms <- data_ms[[3]]$GEN

plot_hist(temp_min_ms, temp_mean_ms, temp_max_ms, month="January", city="Montesummano")

plot_hist(data_ms[[1]]$Medio, data_ms[[2]]$Medio, data_ms[[3]]$Medio,
          month="Overall", city="Montesummano")

```

## 3. Bayesian Model Preparation

### 3.1 Summaries and Extraction

```{r}
ms_means <- data_ms[[2]]
ms_means_yearavg <- ms_means$Medio

cat("Yearly means: \n")
cat(ms_means_yearavg, "\n")

ms_m_ya_length <- length(ms_means_yearavg)
cat("Number of yearly means: \n")
cat(ms_m_ya_length, "\n")

years_ms <- ms_means$Anno
cat("Years: \n")
cat(years_ms, "\n")

```

### 3.2 Standardization

```{r}
years_mean_ms <- mean(years_ms)
cat("Mean year:", years_mean_ms, "\n")

years_sd_ceiling_ms <- ceiling(sd(years_ms))
cat("Ceiling of standard deviation:", years_sd_ceiling_ms, "\n")

years_stdd_ms <- (years_ms - years_mean_ms) / years_sd_ceiling_ms

N_ms <- ms_m_ya_length
cat("Number of observations:", N_ms, "\n")

step_ms <- abs(years_stdd_ms[1] - years_stdd_ms[2]) 
cat("Standardized time step:", step_ms, "\n")

N_fut_steps_ms <- 10
cat("Number of future prediction steps:", N_fut_steps_ms, "\n")

last_observed_time_ms <- max(years_stdd_ms)
time_future_ms <- seq(last_observed_time_ms + step_ms, by = step_ms, length.out = N_fut_steps_ms) 

cat("Future standardized time points:\n")
print(time_future_ms)

stan_data_ms <- list(
  N = N_ms,
  time = years_stdd_ms,
  T = ms_means_yearavg,
  N_future = N_fut_steps_ms,
  time_future = time_future_ms
)
```

## 4. Linear Model Fit (Stan)

### 4.1 MCMC Sampling and Convergence Diagnostics

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
res_ms <- build_fit_stan_model("./Stan/linear_model.stan", stan_data_ms)

mod_ms <- res_ms$mod
fit_ms <- res_ms$fit

stan_T_param_names <- c("T0", "T_dot")

cat("Summary of T parameters:\n")
fit_ms$summary(stan_T_param_names)

cat("Summary of sigma:\n")
fit_ms$summary("sigma")

cat("Running CmdStan diagnostics...\n")
fit_ms$cmdstan_diagnose()

```

### 4.2 95% Credible Intervals

```{r, warning=FALSE}
draws_df_ms <- as_draws_df(fit_ms$draws()) 

quantiles_T_ms <- lapply(
  draws_df_ms[, stan_T_param_names],
  quantile,
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975)
)

cat("T0    : [",
    round(quantiles_T_ms$T0[1], 3), ", ",
    round(quantiles_T_ms$T0[2], 3), "]\n")

cat("T_dot : [",
    round(quantiles_T_ms$T_dot[1], 3), ", ",
    round(quantiles_T_ms$T_dot[2], 3), "]\n")
cat("\n")

```

### 4.3 Parameter Dependencies (Correlation Analysis)

```{r}
cor_plot_ms <- plot_2_correlations(draws_df_ms, stan_T_param_names)
print(cor_plot_ms$plot)
cor_plot_ms$cor 

cor_plot_sigma_0_ms <- plot_2_correlations(draws_df_ms, c("T0", "sigma"))
print(cor_plot_sigma_0_ms$plot)
cor_plot_sigma_0_ms$cor

cor_plot_sigma_dot_ms <- plot_2_correlations(draws_df_ms, c("T_dot", "sigma"))
print(cor_plot_sigma_dot_ms$plot)
cor_plot_sigma_dot_ms$cor

```

### 4.4 Posterior Density and Observational Fitting

```{r}
plot_ms <- plot_posterior(draws_df_ms, 
                          my_x_stdd = stan_data_ms$time, 
                          my_y_data = stan_data_ms$T, 
                          n_grid = N_ms, 
                          n_pred_grid = N_fut_steps_ms,
                          orig_mean = years_mean_ms, 
                          orig_sd = years_sd_ceiling_ms, 
                          my_step = step_ms)
print(plot_ms)
```

### 4.5 MCMC Diagnostic Plots

```{r}
graphs_ms <- plot_various_graphs(fit_ms, c("T0", "T_dot", "sigma"))

print(graphs_ms$trace)
print(graphs_ms$density)
print(graphs_ms$acf)

```

## 5. Constant Model Fit (Stan)

### 5.1 MCMC Sampling and Convergence Diagnostics

```{r, warning=FALSE}
res_c_ms <- build_fit_stan_model("./Stan/constant_model.stan", stan_data_ms)

mod_c_ms <- res_c_ms$mod
fit_c_ms <- res_c_ms$fit

cat("Summary of T, sigma parameters:\n")
fit_c_ms$summary(c("T0", "sigma"))

cat("Running CmdStan diagnostics...\n")
fit_c_ms$cmdstan_diagnose()

```

### 5.2 95% Credible Intervals

```{r, warning=FALSE}
draws_df_c_ms <- as_draws_df(fit_c_ms$draws())

quantiles_c_ms <- lapply(
  draws_df_c_ms[, c("T0", "sigma")],
  quantile,
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975)
)

cat("T0 : [",
    round(quantiles_c_ms$T0[1], 3), ", ",
    round(quantiles_c_ms$T0[2], 3), "]\n")

cat("sigma : [",
    round(quantiles_c_ms$sigma[1], 3), ", ",
    round(quantiles_c_ms$sigma[2], 3), "]\n")
cat("\n")

```

### 5.3 Parameter Dependencies (Correlation Analysis)

```{r, warning=FALSE}
cor_plot_c_ms <- plot_2_correlations(draws_df_c_ms, c("T0", "sigma"))
print(cor_plot_c_ms$plot)
cor_plot_c_ms$cor 

```

### 5.4 Posterior Density and Observational Fitting

```{r}
plot_ms_c <- plot_posterior(draws_df_c_ms, 
                          my_x_stdd = stan_data_ms$time, 
                          my_y_data = stan_data_ms$T, 
                          n_grid = N_ms, 
                          n_pred_grid = N_fut_steps_ms,
                          orig_mean = years_mean_ms, 
                          orig_sd = years_sd_ceiling_ms, 
                          my_step = step_ms)
print(plot_ms_c)

```

### 5.5 MCMC Diagnostic Plots

```{r}
c_graphs_ms <- plot_various_graphs(fit_c_ms, c("T0", "sigma"))
print(c_graphs_ms$trace)
print(c_graphs_ms$density)
print(c_graphs_ms$acf)

```

## 6. Model Comparison

### 6.1 Bayes-Factor Evaluation

```{r}
data_list_ms <- list(T_obs = stan_data_ms$T, time_vec = stan_data_ms$time)

log_marg_lik_linear_ms <- bridge_sampler(
  samples = fit_ms$draws(variables = c("T0", "T_dot", "sigma"), format = "matrix"),
  log_posterior = log_posterior_linear, data = data_list_ms,
  lb = c(T0 = -Inf, T_dot = -Inf, sigma = 0),
  ub = c(T0 = Inf, T_dot = Inf, sigma = Inf),
  method = "normal", silent = TRUE
)

log_marg_lik_constant_ms <- bridge_sampler(
  samples = fit_c_ms$draws(variables = c("T0", "sigma"), format = "matrix"),
  log_posterior = log_posterior_constant, data = data_list_ms,
  lb = c(T0 = -Inf, sigma = 0),
  ub = c(T0 = Inf, sigma = Inf),
  method = "normal", silent = TRUE
)

bf_ms <- bayes_factor(log_marg_lik_linear_ms, log_marg_lik_constant_ms)

cat("BAYES FACTOR MODEL COMPARISON\n\n")
cat("Log Marginal Likelihood (Linear Model):  ", round(log_marg_lik_linear_ms$logml, 3), "\n")
cat("Log Marginal Likelihood (Constant Model):", round(log_marg_lik_constant_ms$logml, 3), "\n")
cat("Bayes Factor (M_Lin / M_Const):          ", round(bf_ms$bf, 3), "\n")

```

### 6.2 Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (LOO-CV)

```{r, warning=FALSE}
log_lik_ms <- fit_ms$draws("log_lik", format = "matrix")
loo_res_ms <- loo(log_lik_ms)

c_log_lik_ms <- fit_c_ms$draws("log_lik", format = "matrix")
c_loo_res_ms <- loo(c_log_lik_ms)

loo_comp_ms <- compare(loo_res_ms, c_loo_res_ms)
elpd_diff_ms <- loo_comp_ms["elpd_diff"]
se_diff_ms   <- loo_comp_ms["se"]

cat("LOO-CV MODEL COMPARISON\n\n")
cat("ELPD difference (M_Lin - M_Const):", round(elpd_diff_ms, 3), "\n")
cat("Standard error:", round(se_diff_ms, 3), "\n")

```

## 7. 10-Year Posterior Predictions (Annual Mean T)

According to MC approximation, predictive distribution (fixed t_new) is the mean value over chains of the likelihood:

$$
T_{\text{new}}(t) \sim \frac{1}{N_{\text{c}}} \sum_{s=1}^{N_{\text{c}}}
\mathcal{N}\!\left(T_0^{(s)} + \dot{T}^{(s)}\, t,\ \sigma^2\right)
$$
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6, echo=FALSE}
plot_predictive_comparison(
  draws_lin = draws_df_ms, 
  draws_const = draws_df_c_ms, 
  time_future = time_future_ms, 
  years_sd = years_sd_ceiling_ms, 
  years_mean = years_mean_ms
)
```

Predictive summary estimations for Linear Model:

```{r}
summary_lin_ms <- predictive_summaries(
  chain = draws_df_ms, 
  time_vector = time_future_ms, 
  model_type = "linear"
)

summary_lin_ms$Year <- round((summary_lin_ms$Time_Step * years_sd_ceiling_ms) + years_mean_ms)
summary_lin_ms_view <- summary_lin_ms[, c("Year", "MAP", "Mean", "SD", "CI_2.5", "CI_97.5")]
print(round(summary_lin_ms_view, 3))
```
Predictive summary estimations for Constant Model (as expected, is constant):

```{r}
summary_c_ms <- predictive_summaries(
  chain = draws_df_c_ms, 
  time_vector = time_future_ms, 
  model_type = "constant"
)

summary_c_ms$Year <- round((summary_c_ms$Time_Step * years_sd_ceiling_ms) + years_mean_ms)
summary_c_ms_view <- summary_c_ms[, c("Year", "MAP", "Mean", "SD", "CI_2.5", "CI_97.5")]
print(round(summary_c_ms_view, 3))
```
Predictions Plot (Linear Model)

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}
full_plot <- plot_ms +
  geom_point(
    data = summary_lin_ms,
    aes(x = Time_Step, y = MAP, color = "MAP Pred."), 
    inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 16, size = 1.5, stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Observations" = "black", 
      "Posterior mean" = "blue", 
      "MAP Pred." = "red"
    )
  )

print(full_plot)
```

Predictions Plot (Constant Model)

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}
full_plot <- plot_ms_c +
  geom_point(
    data = summary_c_ms,
    aes(x = Time_Step, y = MAP, color = "MAP Pred."), 
    inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 16, size = 1.5, stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Observations" = "black", 
      "Posterior mean" = "blue", 
      "MAP Pred." = "red"
    )
  )

print(full_plot)
```

# Cittadella Analysis

In this section follows the forecast analysis for Cittadella station measurements.

## 1. Data Loading

```{r}
data_ci <- find_data("data/Cittadella.csv")
data_ci

```

## 2. Exploratory Visualization

```{r, warning=FALSE}
temp_min_ci <- data_ci[[1]]$GEN
temp_mean_ci <- data_ci[[2]]$GEN
temp_max_ci <- data_ci[[3]]$GEN

plot_hist(temp_min_ci, temp_mean_ci, temp_max_ci, month="January", city="Cittadella")

plot_hist(data_ci[[1]]$Medio, data_ci[[2]]$Medio, data_ci[[3]]$Medio,
          month="Overall", city="Cittadella")

```

## 3. Bayesian Model Preparation

### 3.1 Summaries and Extraction

```{r}
ci_means <- data_ci[[2]]
ci_means_yearavg <- ci_means$Medio

cat("Yearly means: \n")
cat(ci_means_yearavg, "\n")

ci_m_ya_length <- length(ci_means_yearavg)
cat("Number of yearly means: \n")
cat(ci_m_ya_length, "\n")

years_ci <- ci_means$Anno
cat("Years: \n")
cat(years_ci, "\n")

```

### 3.2 Standardization

```{r}
years_mean_ci <- mean(years_ci)
cat("Mean year:", years_mean_ci, "\n")

years_sd_ceiling_ci <- ceiling(sd(years_ci))
cat("Ceiling of standard deviation:", years_sd_ceiling_ci, "\n")

years_stdd_ci <- (years_ci - years_mean_ci) / years_sd_ceiling_ci

N_ci <- ci_m_ya_length
cat("Number of observations:", N_ci, "\n")

step_ci <- abs(years_stdd_ci[1] - years_stdd_ci[2]) 
cat("Standardized time step:", step_ci, "\n")

N_fut_steps_ci <- 10
cat("Number of future prediction steps:", N_fut_steps_ci, "\n")

last_observed_time_ci <- max(years_stdd_ci)
time_future_ci <- seq(last_observed_time_ci + step_ms, by = step_ci, length.out = N_fut_steps_ci)

cat("Future standardized time points:\n")
print(time_future_ci)

stan_data_ci <- list(
  N = N_ci,
  time = years_stdd_ci,
  T = ci_means_yearavg,
  N_future = N_fut_steps_ci,
  time_future = time_future_ci
)

```

## 4. Linear Model Fit (Stan)

### 4.1 MCMC Sampling and Convergence Diagnostics

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
res_ci <- build_fit_stan_model("./Stan/linear_model.stan", stan_data_ci)

mod_ci <- res_ci$mod
fit_ci <- res_ci$fit

cat("Summary of T parameters:\n")
fit_ci$summary(stan_T_param_names)

cat("Summary of sigma:\n")
fit_ci$summary("sigma")

cat("Running CmdStan diagnostics...\n")
fit_ci$cmdstan_diagnose()

```

### 4.2 95% Credible Intervals

```{r, warning=FALSE}
draws_df_ci <- as_draws_df(fit_ci$draws()) 

quantiles_T_ci <- lapply(
  draws_df_ci[, stan_T_param_names],
  quantile,
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975)
)

cat("T0    : [",
    round(quantiles_T_ci$T0[1], 3), ", ",
    round(quantiles_T_ci$T0[2], 3), "]\n")

cat("T_dot : [",
    round(quantiles_T_ci$T_dot[1], 3), ", ",
    round(quantiles_T_ci$T_dot[2], 3), "]\n")
cat("\n")

```

### 4.3 Parameter Dependencies (Correlation Analysis)

```{r, warning=FALSE}
cor_plot_ci <- plot_2_correlations(draws_df_ci, stan_T_param_names)
print(cor_plot_ci$plot)
cor_plot_ci$cor 

cor_plot_sigma_0_ci <- plot_2_correlations(draws_df_ci, c("T0", "sigma"))
print(cor_plot_sigma_0_ci$plot)
cor_plot_sigma_0_ci$cor

cor_plot_sigma_dot_ci <- plot_2_correlations(draws_df_ci, c("T_dot", "sigma"))
print(cor_plot_sigma_dot_ci$plot)
cor_plot_sigma_dot_ci$cor

```

### 4.4 Posterior Density and Observational Fitting

```{r}
plot_ci <- plot_posterior(draws_df_ci, 
                          my_x_stdd = stan_data_ci$time, 
                          my_y_data = stan_data_ci$T, 
                          n_grid = N_ci, 
                          n_pred_grid = N_fut_steps_ci,
                          orig_mean = years_mean_ci, 
                          orig_sd = years_sd_ceiling_ci, 
                          my_step = step_ci)
print(plot_ci)

```

### 4.5 MCMC Diagnostic Plots

```{r}
graphs_ci <- plot_various_graphs(fit_ci, c("T0", "T_dot", "sigma"))

print(graphs_ci$trace)
print(graphs_ci$density)
print(graphs_ci$acf)

```

## 5. Constant Model Fit (Stan)

### 5.1 MCMC Sampling and Convergence Diagnostics

```{r, warning=FALSE}
res_c_ci <- build_fit_stan_model("./Stan/constant_model.stan", stan_data_ci)

mod_c_ci <- res_c_ci$mod
fit_c_ci <- res_c_ci$fit

cat("Summary of T, sigma parameters:\n")
fit_c_ci$summary(c("T0", "sigma"))

cat("Running CmdStan diagnostics...\n")
fit_c_ci$cmdstan_diagnose()

```

### 5.2 95% Credible Intervals

```{r, warning=FALSE}
draws_df_c_ci <- as_draws_df(fit_c_ci$draws())

quantiles_c_ci <- lapply(
  draws_df_c_ci[, c("T0", "sigma")],
  quantile,
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975)
)

cat("T0 : [",
    round(quantiles_c_ci$T0[1], 3), ", ",
    round(quantiles_c_ci$T0[2], 3), "]\n")

cat("sigma : [",
    round(quantiles_c_ci$sigma[1], 3), ", ",
    round(quantiles_c_ci$sigma[2], 3), "]\n")
cat("\n")

```

### 5.3 Parameter Dependencies (Correlation Analysis)

```{r, warning=FALSE}
cor_plot_c_ci <- plot_2_correlations(draws_df_c_ci, c("T0", "sigma"))
print(cor_plot_c_ci$plot)
cor_plot_c_ci$cor 

```

### 5.4 Posterior Density and Observational Fitting

```{r}
plot_ci_c <- plot_posterior(draws_df_c_ci, 
                          my_x_stdd = stan_data_ci$time, 
                          my_y_data = stan_data_ci$T, 
                          n_grid = N_ci, 
                          n_pred_grid = N_fut_steps_ci,
                          orig_mean = years_mean_ci, 
                          orig_sd = years_sd_ceiling_ci, 
                          my_step = step_ci)
print(plot_ci_c)

```

### 5.5 MCMC Diagnostic Plots

```{r}
c_graphs_ci <- plot_various_graphs(fit_c_ci, c("T0", "sigma"))
print(c_graphs_ci$trace)
print(c_graphs_ci$density)
print(c_graphs_ci$acf)

```

## 6. Model Comparison

### 6.1 Bayes-Factor Evaluation

```{r}
data_list_ci <- list(T_obs = stan_data_ci$T, time_vec = stan_data_ci$time)

log_marg_lik_linear_ci <- bridge_sampler(
  samples = fit_ci$draws(variables = c("T0", "T_dot", "sigma"), format = "matrix"),
  log_posterior = log_posterior_linear, data = data_list_ci,
  lb = c(T0 = -Inf, T_dot = -Inf, sigma = 0),
  ub = c(T0 = Inf, T_dot = Inf, sigma = Inf),
  method = "normal", silent = TRUE
)

log_marg_lik_constant_ci <- bridge_sampler(
  samples = fit_c_ci$draws(variables = c("T0", "sigma"), format = "matrix"),
  log_posterior = log_posterior_constant, data = data_list_ci,
  lb = c(T0 = -Inf, sigma = 0),
  ub = c(T0 = Inf, sigma = Inf),
  method = "normal", silent = TRUE
)

bf_ci <- bayes_factor(log_marg_lik_linear_ci, log_marg_lik_constant_ci)

cat("BAYES FACTOR MODEL COMPARISON\n\n")
cat("Log Marginal Likelihood (Linear Model):  ", round(log_marg_lik_linear_ci$logml, 3), "\n")
cat("Log Marginal Likelihood (Constant Model):", round(log_marg_lik_constant_ci$logml, 3), "\n")
cat("Bayes Factor (M_Lin / M_Const):          ", round(bf_ci$bf, 3), "\n")

```

### 6.2 Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (LOO-CV)

```{r, warning=FALSE}
log_lik_ci <- fit_ci$draws("log_lik", format = "matrix")
loo_res_ci <- loo(log_lik_ci)

c_log_lik_ci <- fit_c_ci$draws("log_lik", format = "matrix")
c_loo_res_ci <- loo(c_log_lik_ci)

loo_comp_ci <- compare(loo_res_ci, c_loo_res_ci)
elpd_diff_ci <- loo_comp_ci["elpd_diff"]
se_diff_ci   <- loo_comp_ci["se"]

cat("LOO-CV MODEL COMPARISON\n\n")
cat("ELPD difference (M_Lin - M_Const):", round(elpd_diff_ci, 3), "\n")
cat("Standard error:", round(se_diff_ci, 3), "\n")

```

## 7. 10-Year Posterior Predictions (Annual Mean T)

According to MC approximation, predictive distribution (fixed t_new) is the mean value over chains of the likelihood:

$$
T_{\text{new}}(t) \sim \frac{1}{N_{\text{c}}} \sum_{s=1}^{N_{\text{c}}}
\mathcal{N}\!\left(T_0^{(s)} + \dot{T}^{(s)}\, t,\ \sigma^2\right)
$$
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6, echo=FALSE}
plot_predictive_comparison(
  draws_lin = draws_df_ci, 
  draws_const = draws_df_c_ci, 
  time_future = time_future_ci, 
  years_sd = years_sd_ceiling_ci, 
  years_mean = years_mean_ci
)
```
```{r}
summary_lin_ci <- predictive_summaries(
  chain = draws_df_ci, 
  time_vector = time_future_ci, 
  model_type = "linear"
)

summary_lin_ci$Year <- round((summary_lin_ci$Time_Step * years_sd_ceiling_ci) + years_mean_ci)
summary_lin_ci_view <- summary_lin_ci[, c("Year", "MAP", "Mean", "SD", "CI_2.5", "CI_97.5")]
print(round(summary_lin_ci_view, 3))
```

Predictive summary estimations for Constant Model (as expected, is constant):

```{r}
summary_c_ci <- predictive_summaries(
  chain = draws_df_c_ci, 
  time_vector = time_future_ci, 
  model_type = "constant"
)

summary_c_ci$Year <- round((summary_c_ci$Time_Step * years_sd_ceiling_ci) + years_mean_ci)
summary_c_ci_view <- summary_c_ci[, c("Year", "MAP", "Mean", "SD", "CI_2.5", "CI_97.5")]
print(round(summary_c_ci_view, 3))
```
Predictions Plot (Linear Model)

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}
full_plot <- plot_ci +
  geom_point(
    data = summary_lin_ci,
    aes(x = Time_Step, y = MAP, color = "MAP Pred."), 
    inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 16, size = 1.5, stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Observations" = "black", 
      "Posterior mean" = "blue", 
      "MAP Pred." = "red"
    )
  )

print(full_plot)
```

Predictions Plot (Constant Model)

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}
full_plot <- plot_ci_c +
  geom_point(
    data = summary_c_ci,
    aes(x = Time_Step, y = MAP, color = "MAP Pred."), 
    inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 16, size = 1.5, stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Observations" = "black", 
      "Posterior mean" = "blue", 
      "MAP Pred." = "red"
    )
  )

print(full_plot)
```
